title: Calibration: built-in Hard against Stockfish at UCI_Elo 2600
description: The built-in Hard engine (0.3 s per move, the app's setting) against Stockfish limited to 2600 Elo with the same 0.3 s per move. UCI_Elo is calibrated for long time controls, so treat it as a ladder rung, not a rating for the built-in engine.
hypothesis: Finds the rung of this ladder where the built-in engine stops winning; no direction assumed.
